title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Building Proof of Loss
content:
A building proof of loss on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) is the signed and sworn statement in which an authorized signer of the named insured states the building amount claimed for a date of loss, and it is filed under the policy's claim that carries its latest adjuster report. It is the customer's own sworn statement: the authorized signer signs and swears it, and the customer themselves submits it.

## Situation of use and capability

The building proof of loss records, in the claim file of a General Property Form or RCBAP policy, one sworn building amount for one claim and date of loss. On submission the proof of loss is received into the claim file for the building coverage on that day's date, and the claim file then shows the new building proof of loss with its received date and sworn amount. Nothing is paid by this action.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `sign_building_proof_of_loss_d76eab34`. It belongs to the customer: the agent unlocks it for the customer and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign and swear the proof of loss. One run records one building proof of loss for the stated amount.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `nfipcom_policy_id` | the reference number of the General Property Form or RCBAP policy the claim is made under, as returned by the policy lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `claim_number` | the claim number of the flood claim the proof of loss is sworn for, copied character for character as the customer states it or as it appears on the claim file | verbatim text, digits and punctuation preserved |
| `date_of_loss` | the date the flood loss occurred on that claim | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `claimed_amount` | the building amount sworn on this proof of loss | USD, positive, 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to the cent |

## Return

A receipt with `proof_of_loss_id` (the reference of the new claim-file entry), `claim_number` (the claim it was filed under), `coverage_part` (always `BUILDING`), `claimed_amount` (the sworn amount in USD to 2 decimal places) and `received_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the day of submission). The presence of `proof_of_loss_id` means the proof of loss is on file. No error behaviour is defined beyond this receipt.

## Basis questions

- *Who signs?* An authorized signer of the named insured; the customer themselves runs the handed-over tool.
- *Which claim does it go under?* The policy's claim that carries its latest adjuster report, for that claim's date of loss.
- *Does it pay anything?* No — it records the sworn amount only.
